name: Hands on Hips Countermovement Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Quickly dip into a quarter squat.
Immediately jump as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A jump that begins with a quick dip, with the hands on the hips so power comes from the legs.

safetyNotes: Do it on a firm, non-slip surface; skip if you have knee or ankle injuries.
